import json
prio={5:0,4:1,8:2,2:3}
def transform(g):
    blocks=[g[0:3],g[3:6],g[6:9],g[9:12]]
    out=[]
    for i in range(3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            vals=[b[i][j] for b in blocks if b[i][j]!=0]
            row.append(min(vals,key=lambda v:prio[v]) if vals else 0)
